record.field: LAB (staging only). Schedule a recurring report: a catalogue READ tool (for example pms_discounts_summary or pms_service_nights) run every day, week or month at a local time, over a period relative to each run (previous week, previous month, next week...), delivered to the recipients' chat with OdooBot inside Odoo, computed with each recipient's permissions. Two steps: confirm=false previews the schedule, the next runs and a sample of the report with today's data; show it and, only after the user's approval, call again with confirm=true and the token. send_now=true also sends the first report right away.
LAB (staging only). The scheduled reports I own or receive: what they run, when, the next and last run and how it went. Read only.

LAB (staging only). Pause, resume, cancel, send now or change (period, frequency, day, time, recipients) a scheduled report created with lab_report_schedule. Two steps: confirm=false previews the change; only after the user's approval, confirm=true with the token.
